name: Rulesets & realm types
summary: Five rulesets: Normal, PvP, Roleplay, RP-PvP and Hardcore. Each region has one realm per ruleset, and characters can't move or play between rulesets, so pick the same one as your friends.
steps: Normal: standard PvE, no special rules
PvP: auto-flagged outside your faction's zones, no ganking limits; one faction per account, forced population balance
Roleplay: lore-friendly names enforced; roleplay itself optional; both factions
RP-PvP: Roleplay + PvP rules, one faction
Hardcore (after launch): permanent death; dead characters can transfer out; doesn't use Legacy or Collections from elsewhere, but its progress counts for other rulesets
tips: On PvP and RP-PvP you can only make characters on one faction
Legacy and Collections are account-wide except on Hardcore

name: Race & class combinations
summary: Forever gives six Classic races a new class, and Skyborne classes depend on faction. Only Tauren and Night Elves gained nothing new.
steps: Dwarf (Alliance): Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Shaman (new), Warrior
Gnome (Alliance): Mage, Priest (new), Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Human (Alliance): Hunter (new), Mage, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Night Elf (Alliance): Druid, Hunter, Priest, Rogue, Warrior
Skyborne High Order (Alliance): Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue, Warrior
Orc (Horde): Hunter, Mage (new), Rogue, Shaman, Warlock, Warrior
Tauren (Horde): Druid, Hunter, Shaman, Warrior
Troll (Horde): Hunter, Mage, Priest, Rogue, Shaman, Warlock (new), Warrior
Undead (Horde): Mage, Paladin (new), Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Skyborne Windshaper (Horde): Druid, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warrior
tips: Gnome Priests get two new racials: Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan

name: Rogue poisons
summary: Unlocked through a faction questline from level 20, then applied to weapons (two at a time). In Forever, poisons scale with Attack Power, can crit, and stack with sharpening stones and Windfury Totem.
steps: Instant Poison: unlocked by the Alliance or Horde poison questline
Crippling Poison: Rogue trainer from level 20
Mind-numbing Poison: from level 24
Deadly Poison: from level 30 (30% chance to apply)
Wound Poison: from level 32
tips: Have 80 Lockpicking before starting the questline (level 22 is comfortable for Vanish and Distract)
The Horde questline is much harder than the Alliance one
Opening the Klaven's Tower / Venture Co. chest gives Touch of Zanzil: cure with Anti-Venom, a Shaman/Druid, or the follow-up quest
Poison skill rises 1 per poison, capped at 5x your level
Shady Dealers sell all the materials

name: Rogue lockpicking 1-300
summary: Trained from level 16 with Thieves' Tools; the cap is 5x your level, so 300 needs level 60.
route: 1-110: the Alliance (Redridge, then Lake Everstill footlockers) or Horde (Ratchet, Merchant Coast pirate boat, then Zoram Strand footlockers) questline
110-150: Battered Footlockers in Windshear Mine (Horde), Durnholde Keep (both) or the murloc camps NE of Menethil (Alliance)
150-200: Waterlogged Footlockers at Sar'theris Strand, Desolace (Water Breathing helps); or Mossy Footlockers at Atal'Hakkar after 175; or Angor Fortress, Badlands
200-250: The Slag Pits, Searing Gorge (upper levels after 225), pickpocketing for extra boxes
250-280: Scarlet Footlockers at Tyr's Hand, Eastern Plaguelands (dangerous elites)
280-300: the doors in Blackrock Depths, resetting the instance to repeat
tips: Pick Pocket mid-to-high level mobs for strongboxes
Offer to open lockboxes in city trade chat
